purpose: Teach: 情念/一躍/余力/立脚/密教/縛り/着色/周回

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の情念をくみ取る経営をしろ
lines.en: Listen closely to what our employees need. That's how we lead.
lines.style: Measured, direct authority. Each clause lands with quiet weight. Lean forward slightly on 'listen.' No performance — just clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品が一躍話題となるよう広報を強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll strengthen our communications to make sure the new product gets the attention it deserves.
lines.style: Respectful, efficient affirmation. Steady eye contact. Speaking back what he heard — showing he was actually listening, not just waiting for his turn.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、余力のある時こそ投資しろ
lines.en: And invest when we have the margin to. Don't wait for crisis.
lines.style: Firm. Deliberate pause after 'margin.' This is a principle, not a suggestion. Delivered with the weight of experience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠に立脚した意思決定を徹底します
lines.en: Yes. We'll base every decision on evidence, not intuition.
lines.style: Clipped affirmation. Nod of agreement as he speaks. Quick and competent — he's already thinking through how to implement this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、密教的な経営思想は採用しない
lines.en: We don't adopt management philosophies that hide their reasoning. Transparency is not optional.
lines.style: Sharper this time. A subtle edge — this is about integrity. Slight emphasis on 'transparency.' The room knows he means it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。契約で社員を不当に縛りつけないようにします
lines.en: Understood. We won't use contracts to trap people. Our people stay because they want to.
lines.style: Sincere commitment in his voice. He's moved slightly — this one lands differently. The conviction is visible, not just audible.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商品の着色を環境に優しいものにしろ
lines.en: Make sure the dyes and finishes we use are environmentally responsible. That matters.
lines.style: Deliberate and clear. 'Environmentally responsible' gets steady weight — it's a non-negotiable. Calm but firm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の地域を周回する巡回を強化します
lines.en: Will do. We'll make sure that commitment reaches every region we operate in.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. A touch quieter — the meeting is winding. Professional but slightly warmer, as if sealing an agreement between people who understand each other.
